measurement: balanced unprofiled synchronous public-call host wall times; separate instrumented diagnostics

scope.fusion: explicitly authored DSL expression, no automatic graph fusion
scope.compile: outside timing; cache=False; OS/driver caches retained
scope.output: private generated result; template-copy calls and bytes recorded in diagnostics
scope.cleanup: returned result cleanup and validation excluded; temporaries inside calls included
scope.diagnostics: event intervals include submission gaps/instrumentation/contention; not isolated kernel times; copy event timing absent
scope.recorded_bytes: per host category; nested byte records must not be added as physical traffic

publication.scope: known local identifiers removed; arbitrary text requires review
